machine.ready.gitOptional: Not needed for a blank project. You can keep designing without history.
machine.title: Check your computer
machine.subtitle: Onlook needs a few things on your computer before your first project.
machine.ready.git: Tools Onlook uses to track changes to your projects.
machine.ready.workspace: Where Onlook saves the projects you make.
machine.ready.port: Lets you see your app running while you design.
machine.ready.helper: Keeps your project running in the background.
machine.unconfirmed.line: Couldn’t confirm. You can still continue.
machine.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the prompt. Select it and copy it instead.
machine.helpUnavailable: Couldn’t open that. Open it yourself, then check again.
machine.acting.install: Installing. Your Mac may ask you to confirm.
machine.row.developerTools: Not on your Mac yet. Onlook can install them.
machine.row.gitLicense: Git needs you to accept the Xcode license.
machine.row.gitConfig: Onlook can’t read your Git settings.
machine.row.folder: Onlook can’t save to this folder.
machine.row.permission: Onlook isn’t allowed to save files here.
machine.row.port: Another app is using the preview ports.
machine.detail.developerTools.title: Developer tools didn’t install
machine.detail.developerTools.body: Without them, Onlook can’t track changes to your projects. Your coding agent can install them for you. Copy this prompt and paste it in.
machine.detail.developerTools.prompt: Install Apple's Command Line Tools on my Mac with xcode-select --install, then check that git --version works.
machine.detail.developerTools.again: Still not installed. Check again once the install is done.
machine.detail.gitNotFound.title: Git isn’t installed
machine.detail.gitNotFound.body: Onlook uses Git to track changes to your projects. Install it, or ask your coding agent to.
machine.detail.gitNotFound.prompt: Install Git on my computer, then open a new terminal and check that git --version works.
machine.detail.gitNotFound.again: Still not installed. Check again once Git is installed.
machine.detail.gitLicense.title: Git needs the Xcode license
machine.detail.gitLicense.body: Git won’t run until Apple’s Xcode license is accepted. Open Xcode to accept it, or ask your coding agent to.
machine.detail.gitLicense.prompt: Git on my Mac won't run until Apple's Xcode license is accepted. Accept it, then check that git --version works.
machine.detail.gitLicense.again: Still not accepted. Check again once you’ve accepted the license.
machine.detail.gitConfig.title: Onlook can’t read your Git settings
machine.detail.gitConfig.body: Git can’t read its own settings, so Onlook can’t create a project. Fix the error in your Git config, or ask your coding agent to.
machine.detail.gitConfig.prompt: Running git config --list on my computer fails. Find the error in my Git config files, fix it, then confirm git config --list runs cleanly.
machine.detail.gitConfig.again: Onlook still can’t read your Git settings. Check again once the error is fixed.
machine.detail.gitFailed.title: Git couldn’t create a project
machine.detail.gitFailed.body: Git ran but couldn’t make a repository, so Onlook can’t create a project. Ask your coding agent to find out why.
machine.detail.gitFailed.prompt: Git on my computer can't create a repository. Run git init in an empty folder, find out why it fails, and fix it.
machine.detail.gitFailed.again: Git still can’t create a project. Check again once it’s fixed.
machine.detail.folder.title: Onlook can’t save to this folder
machine.detail.folder.body: Onlook saves your projects in this folder and can’t write to it. Fix the folder’s permissions, or ask your coding agent to.
machine.detail.folder.prompt: Onlook can't write to my Onlook Projects folder. Check its permissions, fix them so my user can write to it, then confirm by creating a file in it.
machine.detail.folder.again: Onlook still can’t save to this folder. Check again once its permissions are fixed.
machine.detail.permission.title: Onlook isn’t allowed to save files here
machine.detail.permission.body: Your computer is blocking Onlook from writing to this folder. Allow access in System Settings, or ask your coding agent to find what’s blocking it.
machine.detail.permission.prompt: My Mac is refusing to let an app write files to my Onlook Projects folder. Find out which permission is blocking it and tell me how to grant access.
machine.detail.permission.again: Onlook still isn’t allowed to save files here. Check again once access is granted.
machine.detail.diskFull.title: Your disk is full
machine.detail.diskFull.body: Onlook needs space to save your project. Free some space, or ask your coding agent to find what’s using it.
machine.detail.diskFull.prompt: My startup disk is full. Find the largest files and folders I can safely remove, and tell me how much space that frees.
machine.detail.diskFull.again: Still full. Check again once you’ve freed some space.
machine.detail.port.title: Another app is using the preview ports
machine.detail.port.body: Onlook shows your app on a port between 4700 and 4799, and another app is using all of them. Close that app, or ask your coding agent to find it.
machine.detail.port.prompt: Something on my computer is using every port from 4700 to 4799 on 127.0.0.1. Find what's listening on those ports and stop it, then confirm they're free.
machine.detail.port.again: Still in use. Check again once that app is closed.
machine.detail.helper.title: The helper didn’t start
machine.detail.helper.body: Onlook runs your project through a background helper, and it didn’t start. Security software often blocks it, so ask your coding agent to check.
machine.detail.helper.prompt: A background helper process launched by an app can't start on my computer. Check whether security software or a policy is blocking it, and tell me how to allow it.
machine.detail.helper.again: The helper still didn’t start. Check again once it’s allowed to run.
machine.choose.title: Choose a folder for Onlook Projects
machine.folderUnavailable: Choose an empty folder that Onlook can write to. Existing projects stay in their current folder.
machine.unavailable: Couldn’t finish the checks. You can continue to create a project.
machine.failure.git_not_found: Git isn’t installed. Install Git, then try again.
machine.failure.developer_tools_missing: Your Mac needs Apple’s developer tools. Install them, then try again.
machine.failure.git_license_unaccepted: Git won’t run until Apple’s Xcode license is accepted. Accept it in Xcode, then try again.
machine.failure.git_config_invalid: Git’s settings can’t be read. In Terminal, fix the error that git config --list reports, then try again.
machine.failure.git_failed: Git couldn’t create a project. In Terminal, run git init in an empty folder to find out why, then try again.
machine.failure.disk_full: Your disk is full. Free some space, then try again.
machine.failure.permission_denied: Your computer is blocking Onlook from writing to your Projects folder. Allow access in System Settings, then try again.
machine.failure.workspace_not_writable: Onlook can’t write to your Projects folder. Fix its permissions, then try again.
machine.failure.no_free_port: Preview ports are in use. Close the apps using ports 4700–4799, then try again.
machine.failure.helper_failed: Onlook’s helper couldn’t start. Allow it in your security software, then try again.
